probes.question: Which volcano's 1815 eruption helped cause the Year Without a Summer?
True or false: Mary Shelley began writing Frankenstein during that cold, gloomy summer of 1816.

panels.text: April 1815. Mount Tambora, on an island in Indonesia, erupts. It is the most powerful eruption in recorded history.
Ash and sulfur gases spread through the atmosphere and dim the sunlight. By 1816 Europe and North America are cold all summer.
Harvests fail and food prices jump. People call 1816 the Year Without a Summer.
The twist: at Villa Diodati in Switzerland, a group of friends is stuck indoors by the gloomy weather. They challenge each other to write ghost stories, and young Mary Shelley begins Frankenstein.
